# Builtin facts

<!-- Generated by `aver facts --markdown > docs/builtin-facts.md`; edit `src/ir/proof_steps/facts.rs`, not this file. -->

A law cites a builtin fact by name in `using`, as it cites a law of its own program. Each fact holds for lists and vectors of every element type, and for maps of every key and value type, so its givens have no type here: `a`, `b`, `c` and `l` are lists, `n` an Int count, `m` a map, `k` and `k2` its keys and `v` its value; in a `Vector.` fact `v` is a vector, `i` and `j` are indices and `x` an element. The proof of each fact is written as steps and travels with every citation: the kernel written in Aver checks it before the law may use the fact, and Lean states the fact once, for every element type, and proves it with the same steps. When the steps stop at a term a fact's left side matches, `aver proof` names the fact in a hint. `aver facts` prints this list.

## `List.len.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.len(List.concat(a, b)) => List.len(a) + List.len(b)
```

## `List.concat.assoc`

```aver
given a, b, c
List.concat(List.concat(a, b), c) => List.concat(a, List.concat(b, c))
```

## `List.concat.rightIdentity`

```aver
given a
List.concat(a, []) => a
```

## `List.len.nonneg`

```aver
given a
List.len(a) >= 0 => true
```

## `List.take.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.take(List.concat(a, b), List.len(a)) => a
```

Proved from `List.len.nonneg`.

## `List.drop.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.drop(List.concat(a, b), List.len(a)) => b
```

Proved from `List.len.nonneg`.

## `List.take.nonPositive`

```aver
given l, n
when n <= 0
List.take(l, n) => []
```

## `List.drop.nonPositive`

```aver
given l, n
when n <= 0
List.drop(l, n) => l
```

## `List.concat.takeDrop`

```aver
given l, n
List.concat(List.take(l, n), List.drop(l, n)) => l
```

## `List.len.ofDropAtMost`

```aver
given l, n
List.len(List.drop(l, n)) <= List.len(l) => true
```

## `List.len.ofReverse`

```aver
given a
List.len(List.reverse(a)) => List.len(a)
```

Proved from `List.len.ofConcat`.

## `List.reverse.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.reverse(List.concat(a, b)) => List.concat(List.reverse(b), List.reverse(a))
```

Proved from `List.concat.assoc`, `List.concat.rightIdentity`.

## `List.reverse.involutive`

```aver
given a
List.reverse(List.reverse(a)) => a
```

Proved from `List.reverse.ofConcat`.

## `Map.get.afterSet`

```aver
given m, k, v
Map.get(Map.set(m, k, v), k) => Option.Some(v)
```

## `Map.get.afterSetOther`

```aver
given m, k, v, k2
when k != k2
Map.get(Map.set(m, k, v), k2) => Map.get(m, k2)
```

## `Map.has.afterSet`

```aver
given m, k, v
Map.has(Map.set(m, k, v), k) => true
```

## `Map.len.afterSetPresent`

```aver
given m, k, v
when Map.has(m, k)
Map.len(Map.set(m, k, v)) => Map.len(m)
```

## `Vector.toList.ofList`

```aver
given l
List.fromVector(Vector.fromList(l)) => l
```

## `Vector.len.asList`

```aver
given v
Vector.len(v) => List.len(List.fromVector(v))
```

## `Vector.len.ofList`

```aver
given l
Vector.len(Vector.fromList(l)) => List.len(l)
```

## `Vector.get.afterSet`

```aver
given v, i, x
when Bool.and(0 <= i, i < Vector.len(v))
Vector.get(Option.withDefault(Vector.set(v, i, x), v), i) => Option.Some(x)
```

## `Vector.get.afterSetOther`

```aver
given v, i, x, j
when Bool.and(Bool.and(0 <= i, i < Vector.len(v)), i != j)
Vector.get(Option.withDefault(Vector.set(v, i, x), v), j) => Vector.get(v, j)
```

## `Vector.len.afterSet`

```aver
given v, i, x
Vector.len(Option.withDefault(Vector.set(v, i, x), v)) => Vector.len(v)
```

## `Vector.get.belowZero`

```aver
given v, i
when i < 0
Vector.get(v, i) => Option.None
```

## `Vector.get.pastEnd`

```aver
given v, i
when i >= Vector.len(v)
Vector.get(v, i) => Option.None
```
